We have become aware that some games are experiencing problems of a blank video screen or the game locking up.
This problem is caused by the Power Supply fitted not maintaining the output voltage correctly.
It is imperative that this Power Supply and Dongle are changed for the new Power Supply and Dongle supplied.
The output voltage of the power supply must be between 4.95 ~ 5.00 volts. When checking or adjusting this voltage ensure that a good quality and accurate Digital Voltmeter is used.
Before commencing with these instructions ensure that the game is working correctly. Repair any faults and replace any faulty items.
1. Switch the game off and disconnect from the power supply.
2. Remove the lower rear door from the Monitor Cabinet.
3. Disconnect six (6) connectors from the right hand Game PCB Assy. (as viewed from the rear of the cabinet.)

14. Use the game test mode (page 44 of the Operators Manual) to re-initialize the game and to confirm that all controls, lamps and switches are working correctly.
